title: Nukleus Office Solutions Ltd - 544370 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Nukleus FY26 total income rose 25.49% YoY to INR 36.19 crore, with PAT of INR 213.53 lakh and EBITDA of INR 917.34 lakh.
summary.overview: FY26 showed strong growth in income and EBITDA, with management attributing margin expansion mainly to technology-led sales and operating productivity. Operational footprint is about 25 centres (17 co-working, 8 managed office) across Delhi NCR and Bengaluru, with roughly 7.3 lakh sq ft under management, about 3.06 lakh sq ft operational (figures differ across answers), and occupancy near 85%. Management is shifting the mix toward managed office and back-to-back deals, guiding to about 10 lakh sq ft operational by end FY27, but declined to give revenue numbers for that capacity. Several slides had revenue-mix errors that management said would be corrected later.

financial_highlights.change: vs INR 92.75 lakh earlier; management stated about 8% increase, which conflicts with the figures quoted

segments.name: Co-working
segments.commentary: Management said co-working grows about 10% a year and carries the highest margin (illustratively about 30%). Its share of the portfolio is falling, from about 70% at IPO to roughly 50% now.

segments.name: Managed office
segments.commentary: Growing about 30-40% a year per management. Targeted to reach about 70% of portfolio in the expansion phase and about 90% over 3-4 years. Illustrative margin about 25%.

segments.name: Back-to-back / enterprise deals
segments.commentary: Illustrative margin about 20%. Landlord-funded fit-outs and revenue-sharing deals are increasing, reducing Nukleus's capex needs.

guidance_outlook: Operational area is expected to reach more than 10 lakh sq ft by end FY27, up from about 3.5 lakh sq ft now; management said this is a 10x rise from the IPO's about 1 lakh sq ft.
Management declined to give a revenue estimate for the current 3.5 lakh sq ft, saying it was too early to quantify.
Management said it intends to sustain the pace of square-footage addition for at least five years, without giving a percentage target.
Plans to expand beyond Delhi NCR and Bengaluru into Pune and Hyderabad, and eventually be a national brand in major cities.
Management said it will be among the biggest operators in three years, without quantifying this.
Management said accounts will move to Ind AS in FY27.
capex_capacity: Centre set-up takes about 3 months; bookings start around month 2; occupancy typically reaches a good level within about 6 months of opening.
Around 7 lakh sq ft under management; about 3.06 lakh sq ft operational per the presentation, while the call cited 3.5-3.6 lakh sq ft operational; the rest is CWIP or under development.
Committed area of about 7.5 lakh sq ft against about 2.5 lakh sq ft expected at IPO; RHP commitment was 1.04 lakh sq ft and the company said it delivered 1.24 lakh sq ft.
Flagship centres include Noida Sector 142 (about 1.5-2 lakh sq ft inventory), Logic Cyber Park, Skymark, IFCO Tower Gurugram and Prestige Blue Chip Bengaluru (Dairy Circle).
demand_pricing: Management cited office leasing of 82.6 million sq ft in CY2025, with GCCs taking about 44% of Q1 2026 absorption (9.1 million sq ft, 48% in Bengaluru).
Management said it is equipped to serve current GCC requirements and has started participating in RFPs; no GCC client signed yet, though it expects to sign its first one soon.
Pricing is set manually per centre to target 85-95% occupancy; dynamic pricing is not used and management said it is four to five years away for the sector.
Management said managed-office clients sign 4-9 year agreements, with revenue starting from day one and no vacancy gap for back-to-back deals.
Management said the client base has moved from startups and SMEs toward Fortune 500 and blue-chip companies, without naming clients.

qa_highlights.question: How will finance costs and leverage evolve?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said finance cost rose to about INR 11.5 lakh from INR 92.75 lakh, described as an 8% increase, while long-term borrowings grew materially. The figures quoted do not reconcile, so the change needs checking against the filed accounts.

qa_highlights.question: What ROCE is targeted on new fixed-asset investment, and when do new centres stabilise?
qa_highlights.answer: No ROCE target was given. Management said centres take about 3 months to build, reach a good occupancy level in about 6 months, and that revenue impact from the 10 lakh sq ft pipeline will fall mainly in FY27-FY28.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the margin gain came from operations versus accounting adjustments?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed most of the gain to productivity. An AI call-filter reportedly cut calls handled per salesperson by 60-70%. No capitalisation adjustment was quantified.

qa_highlights.question: Is demand-based dynamic pricing used, and how does Nukleus compete with larger players?
qa_highlights.answer: Dynamic pricing is not used. Management said the largest operator holds about 1.5 crore sq ft and nobody in the sector is large yet.

qa_highlights.question: What is the current operational area, and how much will be managed office vs co-working?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about 7 lakh sq ft under management, about 3.5 lakh sq ft operational, and over 10 lakh sq ft operational by end FY27, with a mix moving toward 70% managed office and 30% co-working.

qa_highlights.question: Why focus on managed office, and what are the margins and contract terms?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said managed office and back-to-back deals deliver scale and longer contracts, while co-working has higher per-sq-ft profit but is slow to grow. Contracts run 4-9 years.

qa_highlights.question: Will Nukleus adopt Ind AS and use NDS-based EBITDA?
qa_highlights.answer: Nipun Gupta said the accounts will be converted to Ind AS in this financial year (FY27).

risks_watch: Inconsistent figures: the operational area was stated as 3.06 lakh, 3.5 lakh and 3.6 lakh sq ft in different parts of the call; the revenue-mix slide was flagged for correction; and the finance-cost numbers do not reconcile.
Execution risk on the pipeline of more than 10 lakh sq ft operational by end FY27, given a 3-6 month occupancy ramp and the need to fill newly added space.
Rising debt to fund expansion, with management not giving a leverage target and ROCE falling as capital employed grew.
No GCC client signed yet despite RFP participation; GCC conversion is a key watch item.
Related-party and governance questions: a management board member (Pooja Gupta) handles finance, and the company is only about a year post-SME listing.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on growth, technology and national ambitions, but cautious and evasive on numbers: it declined to quantify revenue potential, ROCE targets and client names, and admitted errors in its slides.
key_quotes: So, during the financial year, all the money that we took from the market has been deployed effectively.
We will be one of the biggest in next three years. That is what I can assure you today.
I think there will be a significant growth is better put, putting a number to this is something I don't think is a good idea at this kind of a stage.

adds.what: Operational area to more than 10 lakh sq ft by end FY27, up from about 3.06-3.5 lakh sq ft now

growth.why: Management guides operational area to more than 10 lakh sq ft by end FY27 (about 3x the current 3.06-3.5 lakh sq ft, shown as 10x the IPO level) with a managed-office mix shift, but declined to give any revenue figure and the brief flags inconsistent figures across slides and answers.
